# Salowtech

> Sovereign enterprise software engineering studio. Salowtech architects custom ERP systems, CRM platforms, native/cross-platform mobile apps, cloud web applications, and conversational AI voice assistants. Clients receive 100% source code ownership upon milestone delivery with zero recurring per-seat user license fees.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom CRM Software Development](https://salowtech.com/crm-development): Automated lead capture, WhatsApp Business API sync, omnichannel pipelines, and predictive revenue forecasting with zero per-seat licensing fees.
- [Custom ERP Software Development](https://salowtech.com/erp-development): Multi-plant manufacturing telemetry, automated Indian GST compliance, sovereign ledgers, and real-time inventory control.
- [Custom Web Application Development](https://salowtech.com/web-development): Sub-second full-stack React and Next.js web applications, client self-service portals, and bank-grade secure SaaS platforms.
- [Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)](https://salowtech.com/mobile-app-development): High-performance native iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), and cross-platform Flutter applications with 120 FPS animations and offline-first SQLite sync.
- [Custom HRM & Statutory Payroll](https://salowtech.com/hrm-payroll): Automated biometric attendance integration, leave management, and 100% Indian statutory payroll (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS) compliance.
- [Enterprise AI Voice Assistants](https://salowtech.com/ai-voice-assistant): Sub-500ms latency conversational AI voice and chat bots for telephony, WhatsApp, and websites grounded in proprietary enterprise knowledge (RAG).
- [Technical SEO & Digital Growth](https://salowtech.com/seo-and-growth): Core Web Vitals acceleration, semantic JSON-LD schema architecture, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and high-intent keyword dominance.

## Company Doctrine & Intellectual Property

- **Sovereign Code Ownership**: Clients receive 100% intellectual property, full Git repository transfers, and complete database schemas upon milestone completion.
- **Zero Vendor Lock-In**: No mandatory monthly per-user subscriptions, proprietary runtime lock-in, or forced vendor cloud dependencies. Deploy anywhere: private cloud (AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean) or air-gapped on-premise hardware.
- **Milestone Sprints**: Fixed-scope, sprint-based delivery roadmaps protected by mutual Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
